Here's the short version: **three of your four pieces are already hosted** — Supabase (database/auth) and Cloudinary (media) are SaaS you're already paying nothing for. What you deploy is the static React build, and separately you need something to run the hourly purge. Those are two different decisions.

## Where to put the frontend

Your app is a pure client-side Vite SPA — no SSR, no API routes. Any static host works; the only requirement is a rewrite of unknown paths to `index.html`, because `/admin` and `/w/:slug` are client-side routes.

| Host | Cost | Notes for you |
|---|---|---|
| **Cloudflare Pages** | Free, unlimited bandwidth | **Best fit.** Free tier permits commercial use, and you already have Cloudflare-adjacent tooling. |
| Vercel | Hobby free, **non-commercial only**; Pro ~$20/mo | Excellent DX and preview deploys, but their fair-use rules restrict Hobby to personal projects — if you charge couples, you need Pro. ([Vercel Hobby plan](https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby), [Fair use guidelines](https://vercel.com/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines)) |
| Netlify | Free tier ~100 GB bandwidth/mo | Fine, slightly tighter bandwidth than Pages. |
| Freebuff Sites | Free | I can publish it from here in one step; SPA fallback supported. Good for a quick preview URL rather than a permanent custom domain. |

For a wedding business I'd start on **Cloudflare Pages**: build `npm run build`, output directory `dist`, and a `_redirects` file at `public/_redirects` containing `/* /index.html 200` so a shared `/w/demo-lovebirds` link doesn't 404 on refresh.

## Where to run the purge job

`server/index.js` is an Express app whose only real job is an hourly `node-cron` call to `purgeExpiredWeddings()`, plus `/api/health` and a token-protected `/api/purge`. You do **not** need an always-on server for that:

- **Scheduled GitHub Action** (my pick, $0): a workflow on `cron: '0 * * * *'` that runs the purge function directly. The function is already exported from `server/purge.js`, so it needs no HTTP layer.
- **Cron-as-a-service** (cron-job.org, Upstash QStash) hitting `POST /api/purge` with the `x-api-token` header — but that still requires the Express server to live somewhere, which costs more than the cron itself.
- **Supabase Edge Function + `pg_cron`** — keeps everything in one vendor, but means porting the Cloudinary deletion logic.

Either way, the deletion guarantee (media gone 3 days after the wedding) is your core promise, so don't ship without one of these actually scheduled.

## Five things that will bite you

1. **`VITE_APP_URL` must be your production URL before you build.** It's `http://localhost:5173` in `.env` right now, and it's baked into the QR payload — deploy as-is and every printed QR code points at localhost. This is the single most expensive mistake available here.
2. **No service keys in the frontend host.** Only the four `VITE_*` values get inlined into the JS bundle. `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET` and `PURGE_API_TOKEN` belong only in the GitHub Action / server.
3. **SPA fallback**, as above — otherwise refresh on `/admin` is a 404.
4. **Supabase Auth URLs** — add your domain as Site URL and an allowed redirect in Authentication → URL Configuration; password login works regardless, but future reset/confirmation emails won't.
5. **Cloudinary preset abuse** — your upload preset is unsigned (required for guest uploads). Restrict it to your domain in Cloudinary's preset settings, or strangers can upload to your account with the public preset string.

```bash
npm run build                      # produces dist/
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name our-guests-eyes
```

Yes — Netlify is a fine fit, arguably the least-friction option for this app specifically, because the deployed thing is pure static files. I confirmed there are **zero `/api/*` calls in `src/`**, so you need no functions, no proxy, and no server on Netlify; the only dynamic parts (Supabase, Cloudinary) are called straight from the browser.

One config file plus env vars gets you there. `netlify.toml` at the repo root:

```toml
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[build.environment]
  NODE_VERSION = "20"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
```

The redirect is the part people forget: without it, `/admin` and `/w/demo-lovebirds` work when clicked but 404 on refresh or when a guest opens a shared link. Static assets still resolve normally because Netlify serves real files before applying the rewrite.

Then set these as **build-time** environment variables in Site configuration → Environment variables (or in `.env.production` if you deploy from your machine):

```
VITE_SUPABASE_URL
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
VITE_APP_URL=https://your-site.netlify.app
```

Two things to internalise: Vite inlines these at build time (changing one requires a redeploy, not just a restart), and **`VITE_APP_URL` is what gets encoded into the QR codes** — leave it as localhost and every printed QR code is dead. Do not add `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET` or `PURGE_API_TOKEN` here; anything not prefixed `VITE_` is simply unused by the bundle, but there's no reason to have secrets sitting in the frontend host.

To get a live URL in about a minute, without Git:

```bash
npm run build
npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
```

or connect the repo for automatic deploys on push. Custom domain and HTTPS come with it.

Two Netlify-specific caveats worth knowing before you commit:

- **The free plan is now credit-based.** As of the September 2025 pricing change, plans consume credits for bandwidth, production deploys and requests, with a hard monthly cap that pauses sites rather than billing you ([Netlify pricing](https://www.netlify.com/pricing/), [credit explainer](https://www.netlify.com/blog/introducing-netlify-free-plan/)). Reported figures are ~300 credits/month on Free, where each production deploy costs credits — so frequent redeploys, not traffic, are what usually runs it out. Your heavy bytes (photos/videos) come from Cloudinary, so Netlify only serves ~200 KB of JS/CSS per visit. Check the current numbers in your dashboard rather than trusting blog posts.
- **New projects start private** on credit-based accounts — you must explicitly publish the deploy to make the URL public. Also, unlike Vercel Hobby, Netlify's free plan doesn't carry the explicit non-commercial restriction, which matters if you're charging couples.

The purge job is unchanged by this: the hourly `node-cron` in `server/index.js` still needs somewhere to run. Netlify *can* host it as a scheduled function, but that means porting `purgeExpiredWeddings()` into a Netlify function — whereas a scheduled GitHub Action can call the existing exported function as-is, with no porting and no host.

Here's the short version: **three of your four pieces are already hosted** — Supabase (database/auth) and Cloudinary (media) are SaaS you're already paying nothing for. What you deploy is the static React build, and separately you need something to run the hourly purge. Those are two different decisions.

## Where to put the frontend

Your app is a pure client-side Vite SPA — no SSR, no API routes. Any static host works; the only requirement is a rewrite of unknown paths to `index.html`, because `/admin` and `/w/:slug` are client-side routes.

| Host | Cost | Notes for you |

Yes — Netlify is a fine fit, arguably the least-friction option for this app specifically, because the deployed thing is pure static files. I confirmed there are **zero `/api/*` calls in `src/`**, so you need no functions, no proxy, and no server on Netlify; the only dynamic parts (Supabase, Cloudinary) are called straight from the browser.

One config file plus env vars gets you there. `netlify.toml` at the repo root:

```toml
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[build.environment]
  NODE_VERSION = "20"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
```

The redirect is the part people forget: without it, `/admin` and `/w/demo-lovebirds` work when clicked but 404 on refresh or when a guest opens a shared link. Static assets still resolve normally because Netlify serves real files before applying the rewrite.

Then set these as **build-time** environment variables in Site configuration → Environment variables (or in `.env.production` if you deploy from your machine):

```
VITE_SUPABASE_URL
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
VITE_APP_URL=https://your-site.netlify.app
```

Two things to internalise: Vite inlines these at build time (changing one requires a redeploy, not just a restart), and **`VITE_APP_URL` is what gets encoded into the QR codes** — leave it as localhost and every printed QR code is dead. Do not add `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET` or `PURGE_API_TOKEN` here; anything not prefixed `VITE_` is simply unused by the bundle, but there's no reason to have secrets sitting in the frontend host.

To get a live URL in about a minute, without Git:

```bash
npm run build
npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
```

or connect the repo for automatic deploys on push. Custom domain and HTTPS come with it.

Two Netlify-specific caveats worth knowing before you commit:

- **The free plan is now credit-based.** As of the September 2025 pricing change, plans consume credits for bandwidth, production deploys and requests, with a hard monthly cap that pauses sites rather than billing you ([Netlify pricing](https://www.netlify.com/pricing/), [credit explainer](https://www.netlify.com/blog/introducing-netlify-free-plan/)). Reported figures are ~300 credits/month on Free, where each production deploy costs credits — so frequent redeploys, not traffic, are what usually runs it out. Your heavy bytes (photos/videos) come from Cloudinary, so Netlify only serves ~200 KB of JS/CSS per visit. Check the current numbers in your dashboard rather than trusting blog posts.
- **New projects start private** on credit-based accounts — you must explicitly publish the deploy to make the URL public. Also, unlike Vercel Hobby, Netlify's free plan doesn't carry the explicit non-commercial restriction, which matters if you're charging couples.

The purge job is unchanged by this: the hourly `node-cron` in `server/index.js` still needs somewhere to run. Netlify *can* host it as a scheduled function, but that means porting `purgeExpiredWeddings()` into a Netlify function — whereas a scheduled GitHub Action can call the existing exported function as-is, with no porting and no host.

Your code built fine — 185 modules, `dist/` written, exit 0. What failed was the step *after* it: Netlify's **secrets scanner**, and it flagged something that isn't a secret.

## What actually triggered it

The flagged value is the string `4000`, the value of `SERVER_PORT`. The scanner substring-matches secret values against repo files and build output, so `4000` matched unrelated numbers:

| Match | Real meaning |
|---|---|
| `86400000` in [CountdownBanner.jsx:18](src/components/ui/CountdownBanner.jsx#L18), [WeddingCard.jsx:14](src/components/admin/WeddingCard.jsx#L14), [EventStats.jsx:36](src/components/admin/EventStats.jsx#L36) | milliseconds per day |
| `4000` in [GuestGallery.jsx:26](src/pages/wedding/GuestGallery.jsx#L26) and line 160 | a blob-URL revoke timeout |
| `localhost:4000` in [vite.config.js:9](vite.config.js#L9), [README.md](README.md#L7), [server/index.js:44](server/index.js#L44) | the local purge server's port |

Nine "leaks", one harmless number. The real problem is that `SERVER_PORT` (plus your other server-side values) are sitting in your **frontend** host, where the build has no use for them — nothing in `src/` reads `SERVER_PORT`, and Netlify never runs `server/index.js`.

## The fix I applied

New [netlify.toml](netlify.toml) — you were building with UI-only settings, so the file now defines everything explicitly:

- `command = "npm run build"`, `publish = "dist"` (same as your UI settings)
- `NODE_VERSION = "22"`
- `SECRETS_SCAN_OMIT_KEYS = "SERVER_PORT"` — skips scanning that one non-secret key, leaving all real secrets scanned
- **SPA fallback** `/* → /index.html 200` with status 200. You were missing this, and it's not cosmetic: `/admin` and `/w/demo-lovebirds` work when clicked but **404 on refresh**, and every guest opening a shared QR link hits it cold. Real files in `dist/` still win over the rule.

Verified: the TOML parses to the expected structure, and `npm run build` still passes locally (6.5s). I can't run Netlify's scanner from here, so the scan itself is proven only by your next deploy.

## Two things to do on Netlify's side

**1. Delete the server-only variables** in Project configuration → Environment variables. Keep only the five `VITE_*` ones:

`SERVER_PORT`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`, `PURGE_API_TOKEN`, `TEST_OWNER_EMAIL`, `TEST_OWNER_PASSWORD` → remove. That's the actual fix; the omit key is only a belt-and-braces for the port number. Those secrets belong wherever the purge job ends up running, not on a host that serves public JS.

**2. Commit and push `netlify.toml`.** It's untracked right now, so Netlify hasn't seen it.

If the next deploy *still* fails on `SERVER_PORT`, the scanner read the config from the UI rather than the file — add `SECRETS_SCAN_OMIT_KEYS = SERVER_PORT` in Project configuration → Environment variables too (Netlify documents those scan settings as site/team env vars, and `netlify.toml` support for them is less clearly documented).

## Check before you scan a real QR code

`VITE_APP_URL` must be your deployed origin (`https://your-site.netlify.app` or your custom domain), because it's baked into the QR payload at build time. If it's still `http://localhost:5173`, the build will succeed and every printed QR code will point at a dead localhost URL.

Two side notes: nothing in `src/` calls `/api`, so you need no Netlify functions — the `vite.config.js` proxy is dev-only. And `git status` shows `.env.example` as deleted in your working tree; that wasn't me, so decide whether you want that deletion in the commit.

Progress note:
Yes — Netlify is a fine fit, arguably the least-friction option for this app specifically, because the deployed thing is pure static files. I confirmed there are **zero `/api/*` calls in `src/`**, so you need no functions, no proxy, and no server on Netlify; the only dynamic parts (Supabase, Cloudinary) are called straight from the browser.

One config file plus env vars gets you there. `netlify.toml` at the repo root:

```toml
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[build.environment]
  NODE_VERSION = "20"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
```

The redirect is the part people forget: without it, `/admin` and `/w/demo-lovebirds` work when clicked but 404 on refresh or when a guest opens a shared link. Static assets still resolve normally because Netlify serves real files before applying the rewrite.

Then set these as **build-time** environment variables in Site configuration → Environment variables (or in `.env.production` if you deploy from your machine):

```
VITE_SUPABASE_URL
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
VITE_APP_URL=https://your-site.netlify.app
```

Two things to internalise: Vite inlines these at build time (changing one requires a redeploy, not just a restart), and **`VITE_APP_URL` is what gets encoded into the QR codes** — leave it as localhost and every printed QR code is dead. Do not add `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET` or `PURGE_API_TOKEN` here; anything not prefixed `VITE_` is simply unused by the bundle, but there's no reason to have secrets sitting in the frontend host.

To get a live URL in about a minute, without Git:

```bash
npm run build
npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
```

or connect the repo for automatic deploys on push. Custom domain and HTTPS come with it.

Two Netlify-specific caveats worth knowing before you commit:

- **The free plan is now credit-based.** As of the September 2025 pricing change, plans consume credits for bandwidth, production deploys and requests, with a hard monthly cap that pauses sites rather than billing you ([Netlify pricing](https://www.netlify.com/pricing/), [credit explainer](https://www.netlify.com/blog/introducing-netlify-free-plan/)). Reported figures are ~300 credits/month on Free, where each production deploy costs credits — so frequent redeploys, not traffic, are what usually runs it out. Your heavy bytes (photos/videos) come from Cloudinary, so Netlify only serves ~200 KB of JS/CSS per visit. Check the current numbers in your dashboard rather than trusting blog posts.
- **New projects start private** on credit-based accounts — you must explicitly publish the deploy to make the URL public. Also, unlike Vercel Hobby, Netlify's free plan doesn't carry the explicit non-commercial restriction, which matters if you're charging couples.

The purge job is unchanged by this: the hourly `node-cron` in `server/index.js` still needs somewhere to run. Netlify *can* host it as a scheduled function, but that means porting `purgeExpiredWeddings()` into a Netlify function — whereas a scheduled GitHub Action can call the existing exported function as-is, with no porting and no host.

Progress note:
Your code built fine — 185 modules, `dist/` written, exit 0. What failed was the step *after* it: Netlify's **secrets scanner**, and it flagged something that isn't a secret.

## What actually triggered it

The flagged value is the string `4000`, the value of `SERVER_PORT`. The scanner substring-matches secret values against repo files and build output, so `4000` matched unrelated numbers:

| Match | Real meaning |
|---|---|
| `86400000` in [CountdownBanner.jsx:18](src/components/ui/CountdownBanner.jsx#L18), [WeddingCard.jsx:14](src/components/admin/WeddingCard.jsx#L14), [EventStats.jsx:36](src/components/admin/EventStats.jsx#L36) | milliseconds per day |
| `4000` in [GuestGallery.jsx:26](src/pages/wedding/GuestGallery.jsx#L26) and line 160 | a blob-URL revoke timeout |
| `localhost:4000` in [vite.config.js:9](vite.config.js#L9), [README.md](README.md#L7), [server/index.js:44](server/index.js#L44) | the local purge server's port |

Nine "leaks", one harmless number. The real problem is that `SERVER_PORT` (plus your other server-side values) are sitting in your **frontend** host, where the build has no use for them — nothing in `src/` reads `SERVER_PORT`, and Netlify never runs `server/index.js`.

## The fix I applied

New [netlify.toml](netlify.toml) — you were building with UI-only settings, so the file now defines everything explicitly:

- `command = "npm run build"`, `publish = "dist"` (same as your UI settings)
- `NODE_VERSION = "22"`
- `SECRETS_SCAN_OMIT_KEYS = "SERVER_PORT"` — skips scanning that one non-secret key, leaving all real secrets scanned
- **SPA fallback** `/* → /index.html 200` with status 200. You were missing this, and it's not cosmetic: `/admin` and `/w/demo-lovebirds` work when clicked but **404 on refresh**, and every guest opening a shared QR link hits it cold. Real files in `dist/` still win over the rule.

Verified: the TOML parses to the expected structure, and `npm run build` still passes locally (6.5s). I can't run Netlify's scanner from here, so the scan itself is proven only by your next deploy.

## Two things to do on Netlify's side

**1. Delete the server-only variables** in Project configuration → Environment variables. Keep only the five `VITE_*` ones:

`SERVER_PORT`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`, `PURGE_API_TOKEN`, `TEST_OWNER_EMAIL`, `TEST_OWNER_PASSWORD` → remove. That's the actual fix; the omit key is only a belt-and-braces for the port number. Those secrets belong wherever the purge job ends up running, not on a host that serves public JS.

**2. Commit and push `netlify.toml`.** It's untracked right now, so Netlify hasn't seen it.

If the next deploy *still* fails on `SERVER_PORT`, the scanner read the config from the UI rather than the file — add `SECRETS_SCAN_OMIT_KEYS = SERVER_PORT` in Project configuration → Environment variables too (Netlify documents those scan settings as site/team env vars, and `netlify.toml` support for them is less clearly documented).

## Check before you scan a real QR code

`VITE_APP_URL` must be your deployed origin (`https://your-site.netlify.app` or your custom domain), because it's baked into the QR payload at build time. If it's still `http://localhost:5173`, the build will succeed and every printed QR code will point at a dead localhost URL.

Nothing was removed on my side, and nothing in the code changed — the Cloudinary integration is intact. Let me be precise about which "Cloudinary" you mean, because there are three different things with that name in this project.

## How a photo actually leaves a guest's phone

It never goes through Netlify. [src/lib/cloudinary.js](src/lib/cloudinary.js) has the browser POST the file straight to Cloudinary:

```
POST https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/<cloud_name>/image|video/upload
     form: file=<the photo>, upload_preset=<unsigned preset>
```

That's an **unsigned** upload — no signature, no API key, no secret, no server in between. [UploadModal.jsx](src/components/wedding/UploadModal.jsx) uploads each file, then writes the returned `public_id` + `secure_url` into the `media` table in Supabase. This is exactly why the app needs no Netlify Function: a 100 MB video would blow past function payload limits, but a direct browser upload doesn't care.

So the only two values the upload path needs are:

| Variable | Read by | Drives |
|---|---|---|
| `VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME` | browser ([cloudinary.js:1](src/lib/cloudinary.js#L1)) | which Cloudinary account |
| `VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET` | browser ([cloudinary.js:2](src/lib/cloudinary.js#L2)) | the unsigned preset rules |

## Which removal breaks what

**1. If you removed `VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME` / `VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET` from Netlify** — yes, uploads stop. `cloudinaryReady` becomes false, the modal shows "Uploads are not configured yet" and the upload button is disabled. The app doesn't crash; sharing is just dead. These two must stay in Netlify, and because Vite inlines them at build time you have to **redeploy** after adding them back, not just restart.

**2. If you removed `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` / `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`** — uploads keep working perfectly. Those two are never used by a guest upload; they exist only so the purge job can *delete* media later ([server/cloudinary.js](server/cloudinary.js)). Deleting them from Netlify is correct and harmless.

But know the consequence: [server/cloudinary.js](server/cloudinary.js) only warns when credentials are incomplete, and [purge.js](server/purge.js) deletes the wedding and all its Supabase rows **regardless** of whether the Cloudinary deletion succeeded. So without those two secrets wherever the purge runs, expired weddings vanish from the app while their photos and videos sit in your Cloudinary account forever. That's the 3-day promise quietly breaking, with no error to tell you.

**3. If you removed `SERVER_PORT` / `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` / `PURGE_API_TOKEN`** — that's what I recommended, and it has no effect on uploads. `SERVER_PORT` is the local Express port; the other two are for the purge job.

## The thing worth knowing about unsigned uploads

Because the preset is public by design, anyone who views your JS bundle can read your cloud name and preset and upload to your account — that's the tradeoff that lets 200 guests upload with zero backend. Harden it in Cloudinary → Settings → Upload → your preset: restrict **allowed formats** (`jpg,png,heic,mp4,mov`), set **max file size** (20 MB / 100 MB to match the client limits), set a **folder** (e.g. `our-guests-eyes`), and consider enabling moderation. That way a stranger with your preset can't dump arbitrary files or files larger than you expect.

Net effect: for your Netlify deploy, keep the five `VITE_*` vars (including the two Cloudinary ones) and drop everything else. Uploads flow browser → Cloudinary → Supabase metadata, and Netlify only ever serves the ~200 KB of JS/CSS.

{"kind":"tool","id":"i8gMvu12q3c","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"scripts/generate-icons.mjs","instructions":"Add a temporary generator for the app icons.","content":"// One-off icon generator: writes the PWA/apple-touch PNGs with no dependencies.
import { deflateSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';

const CREAM = [250, 246, 239];
const ROSE = [201, 138, 138];
const GOLD = [201, 169, 106];

const crcTable = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, n) => {
  let c = n;
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
  return c >>> 0;
});

function crc32(buf) {
  let c = 0xffffffff;
  for (const byte of buf) c = crcTable[(c ^ byte) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
  return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function chunk(type, data) {
  const len = Buffer.alloc(4);
  len.writeUInt32BE(data.length);
  const body = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type, 'ascii'), data]);
  const crc = Buffer.alloc(4);
  crc.writeUInt32BE(crc32(body));
  return Buffer.concat([len, body, crc]);
}

function encodePng(size, pixels) {
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(size, 0);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(size, 4);
  ihdr[8] = 8; // bit depth
  ihdr[9] = 6; // RGBA
  const raw = Buffer.alloc(size * (size * 4 + 1));
  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    raw[y * (size * 4 + 1)] = 0;
    pixels.copy(raw, y * (size * 4 + 1) + 1, y * size * 4, (y + 1) * size * 4);
  }
  return Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]),
    chunk('IHDR', ihdr),
    chunk('IDAT', deflateSync(raw, { level: 9 })),
    chunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0)),
  ]);
}

// Classic heart implicit: (x^2 + y^2 - 1)^3 - x^2 * y^3 <= 0, with y up.
function inHeart(px, py) {
  const x = px;
  const y = py;
  const a = x * x + y * y - 1;
  return a * a * a - x * x * y * y * y <= 0;
}

function mix(a, b, t) {
  return a.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (b[i] - v) * t));
}

function render(size, { artScale }) {
  const pixels = Buffer.alloc(size * size * 4);
  const cx = size / 2;
  const cy = size / 2;
  const ringRadius = size * 0.383;
  const ringWidth = Math.max(2, size * 0.0137);
  const heartScale = (size * 0.6 * artScale) / 2.4;
  const ss = 3; // supersampling grid for smooth edges
  const ringColor = mix(CREAM, GOLD, 0.5);

  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      let heartHits = 0;
      let ringHits = 0;
      for (let sy = 0; sy < ss; sy++) {
        for (let sx = 0; sx < ss; sx++) {
          const px = x + (sx + 0.5) / ss;
          const py = y + (sy + 0.5) / ss;
          const dx = px - cx;
          const dy = py - cy;
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (Math.abs(dist - ringRadius) <= ringWidth / 2) ringHits++;
          if (inHeart(dx / heartScale, -(dy / heartScale))) heartHits++;
        }
      }
      const total = ss * ss;
      let color = CREAM;
      if (ringHits) color = mix(color, ringColor, ringHits / total);
      if (heartHits) color = mix(color, ROSE, heartHits / total);
      const i = (y * size + x) * 4;
      pixels[i] = color[0];
      pixels[i + 1] = color[1];
      pixels[i + 2] = color[2];
      pixels[i + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  return encodePng(size, pixels);
}

mkdirSync('public/icons', { recursive: true });
writeFileSync('public/icons/icon-512.png', render(512, { artScale: 1 }));
writeFileSync('public/icons/icon-192.png', render(192, { artScale: 1 }));
writeFileSync('public/icons/icon-maskable-512.png', render(512, { artScale: 0.82 }));
writeFileSync('public/apple-touch-icon.png', render(180, { artScale: 1 }));
console.log('icons written');

The app is now installable as a standalone app — that's the only way a browser will give you a true full-screen, no-address-bar launch. A normal tab can't be forced fullscreen without the visitor pressing a button (and on iPhone Safari, `requestFullscreen` isn't available at all).

## What I added

**[public/manifest.webmanifest](public/manifest.webmanifest)** — `"display": "standalone"` with an `override` of `standalone` → `minimal-ui`, cream `theme_color`/`background_color`, `start_url: "/"`, and three icons (192, 512, plus a maskable 512 so Android's circle/squircle masking doesn't clip the artwork).

**Icons** — generated [icon-192.png](public/icons/icon-192.png), [icon-512.png](public/icons/icon-512.png), [icon-maskable-512.png](public/icons/icon-maskable-512.png) and [apple-touch-icon.png](public/apple-touch-icon.png) in your palette: rose heart, gold ring, cream field. They're real PNGs at the sizes each platform demands, not a re-scaled emoji.

**[index.html](index.html)** — manifest link, `apple-touch-icon`, `mobile-web-app-capable`, `apple-mobile-web-app-capable`, and `apple-mobile-web-app-title = "Guest Eyes"` so the home-screen label isn't truncated to "Our Gues…".

**[public/sw.js](public/sw.js)** + registration in [main.jsx](src/main.jsx) — a deliberately no-op service worker. Chrome won't offer installation without one, but this one caches nothing: every request goes straight to the network, so a new Netlify deploy shows up immediately instead of serving a stale bundle. Registration is guarded with `import.meta.env.PROD`, so your dev server is never shadowed by it.

## How you actually get full screen

Deploy first (HTTPS is required), then:

- **Android Chrome** — you'll get an install prompt, or use ⋮ → *Install app* / *Add to Home screen*. It launches with no URL bar.
- **iPhone Safari** — Share → *Add to Home Screen*. Launching from the icon opens standalone, edge-to-edge.
- **Desktop Chrome/Edge** — the install icon in the address bar opens it in its own window, without tabs.

I set the iOS status bar to `default` rather than translucent, so the layout isn't pushed under the notch — your hero still starts below the clock.

## Verified

Served the production build (`vite preview`, then shut it down) and checked over HTTP and in the browser:

- `/manifest.webmanifest` → 200, `application/manifest+json`, parses with `display: standalone` and all three icon entries
- `/icons/icon-192.png`, `/icons/icon-512.png`, `/icons/icon-maskable-512.png`, `/apple-touch-icon.png` → 200, `image/png`
- `/sw.js` → 200; service worker **active**, scope `/`
- `index.html` carries the manifest link and all four iOS/mobile meta tags
- `npm run build` passes; `public/` is copied into `dist/`, so Netlify will publish these files automatically

What I could not verify is the install prompt itself — that needs a real device or browser UI I can't drive. Also worth knowing: if you had already added the site to a home screen before this, remove and re-add it to pick up the new icon and standalone mode.

Nothing else in the layout changed; the gallery already uses `min-h-dvh`, so it fills the viewport in standalone mode.

{"kind":"tool","id":"i_QycyVeeoY","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src/components/feed/ReelFeed.jsx","content":"import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import Modal from '../ui/Modal.jsx';
import Avatar from './Avatar.jsx';
import { filterCss } from '../../lib/constants.js';
import { CommentIcon, HeartIcon, MuteIcon, PauseIcon, SendIcon } from './icons.jsx';

function Reel({
  media,
  author,
  likedByMe,
  likeCount,
  commentCount,
  muted,
  onToggleMute,
  onToggleLike,
  onOpenComments,
  onDownload,
}) {
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  // Play only the reel occupying most of the screen; pause the rest.
  useEffect(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return undefined;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          video.play().then(() => setPaused(false)).catch(() => {});
        } else {
          video.pause();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.6 },
    );
    observer.observe(video);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.muted = muted;
  }, [muted]);

  const togglePlay = () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (video.paused) {
      video.play().then(() => setPaused(false)).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      video.pause();
      setPaused(true);
    }
  };

  const filterLabel = media.filter_name && media.filter_name !== 'none' ? media.filter_name : null;

  return (
    <section className="relative h-full w-full snap-start snap-always overflow-hidden bg-black">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        src={media.url}
        loop
        muted={muted}
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        onClick={togglePlay}
        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
        style={{ filter: filterCss(media.filter_name) }}
      />

      {paused && (
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-cream/80">
          <PauseIcon className="h-14 w-14" />
        </span>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onToggleMute}
        aria-label={muted ? 'Unmute video' : 'Mute video'}
        className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-black/45 p-2 text-cream backdrop-blur"
      >
        <MuteIcon muted={muted} className="h-5 w-5" />
      </button>

      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-48 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/35 to-transparent" />

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-end justify-between gap-4 p-4 pb-5">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-cream">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Avatar name={author} size="sm" ring />
            <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{author}</p>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-cream/60">· {dayjs(media.created_at).format('D MMM')}</span>
          </div>
          {media.caption && <p className="mt-2 line-clamp-3 text-[13px] leading-snug text-cream/90">{media.caption}</p>}
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-cream/60">
            {filterLabel ? `${filterLabel} filter · ` : ''}original audio
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5 pb-2 text-cream">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleLike}
            aria-pressed={likedByMe}
            aria-label={likedByMe ? 'Unlike reel' : 'Like reel'}
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1"
          >
            <HeartIcon filled={likedByMe} className={`h-7 w-7 ${likedByMe ? 'text-rose' : ''}`} />
            <span className="text-[11px]">{likeCount}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenComments}
            aria-label="Open comments"
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1"
          >
            <CommentIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
            <span className="text-[11px]">{commentCount}</span>
          </button>

          <button type="button" onClick={onDownload} aria-label="Download this reel" className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
            <SendIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function ReelFeed({
  reels,
  guestNameById,
  likes,
  comments,
  session,
  onToggleLike,
  onAddComment,
  onDownload,
  emptyState,
}) {
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true);
  const [commentReelId, setCommentReelId] = useState(null);

  if (!reels.length) return emptyState;

  const commentReel = reels.find((reel) => reel.id === commentReelId) || null;
  const reelComments = commentReel ? comments.filter((comment) => comment.media_id === commentReel.id) : [];

  const submitComment = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const input = event.target.elements.reelComment;
    const body = input.value.trim();
    if (!body || !commentReel) return;
    await onAddComment(commentReel.id, body);
    input.value = '';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="oge-feed-height snap-y snap-mandatory overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-black">
        {reels.map((media) => {
          const reelLikes = likes.filter((like) => like.media_id === media.id);
          const reelCommentCount = comments.filter((comment) => comment.media_id === media.id).length;
          return (
            <Reel
              key={media.id}
              media={media}
              author={guestNameById[media.guest_id] || 'A guest'}
              likedByMe={Boolean(session && reelLikes.some((like) => like.guest_id === session.guestId))}
              likeCount={reelLikes.length}
              commentCount={reelCommentCount}
              muted={muted}
              onToggleMute={() => setMuted((value) => !value)}
              onToggleLike={() => onToggleLike(media.id)}
              onOpenComments={() => setCommentReelId(media.id)}
              onDownload={() => onDownload(media)}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <Modal open={Boolean(commentReel)} onClose={() => setCommentReelId(null)} title="Comments">
        {reelComments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-brown/50">No comments yet — be the first.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="max-h-[45dvh] space-y-3 overflow-y-auto pb-2">
            {reelComments.map((comment) => (
              <li key={comment.id} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <Avatar name={comment.guests?.full_name || 'Guest'} size="sm" />
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-brown-dark">{comment.guests?.full_name || 'Guest'}</p>
                  <p className="text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink/85">{comment.body}</p>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        {session && commentReel && (
          <form onSubmit={submitComment} className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-brown/10 pt-3">
            <input
              name="reelComment"
              className="oge-input flex-1 py-2 text-sm"
              placeholder="Add a comment…"
              maxLength={300}
              aria-label="Add a comment"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="oge-btn-gold px-4 py-2 text-xs">
              Post
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

function NoteCard({ note, author }) {

      <header className="flex items-center gap-3">

        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-brown/35">note</span>
      </header>

      <p
        onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
        className={`mt-2.5 whitespace-pre-wrap font-body text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink/90 ${expanded ? '' : 'line-clamp-5'}`}
      >
        {note.body}
      </p>
    </article>
  );
}

export default function NotesFeed({ messages, loading, canWrite, onSubmit, session, emptyState }) {
  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const submit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!body.trim()) return;
    setSending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onSubmit(body.trim());
      setBody('');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'The note could not be posted.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[470px] space-y-3 px-3 py-4">

        <form onSubmit={submit} className="rounded-2xl border border-brown/10 bg-white p-3 shadow-card">

            <Avatar name={session?.fullName || 'Guest'} size="md" ring />
            <textarea
              value={body}
              onChange={(event) => setBody(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Leave a note for the newlyweds…"
              maxLength={1000}
              rows={3}
              className="min-h-[74px] flex-1 resize-y bg-transparent font-body text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink placeholder:text-brown/40 focus:outline-none"

            <button type="submit" className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-gold hover:text-brown" disabled={sending || !body.trim()}>
              {sending ? 'Posting…' : 'Post note'}
            </button>

          {error && <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-rose-dark">{error}</p>}
        </form>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-brown/50">Opening the notes…</p>
      ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
        emptyState
      ) : (
        messages.map((message) => (
          <NoteCard
            key={message.id}
            note={message}
            author={message.guests?.full_name || 'A guest'}
          />
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import JSZip from 'jszip';
import { useEvent } from '../../context/EventContext.jsx';
import { useCountdown } from '../../hooks/useCountdown.js';
import { useEventInteractions } from '../../hooks/useEventInteractions.js';
import { useGuestbook } from '../../hooks/useGuestbook.js';
import { supabase, supabaseReady } from '../../lib/supabase.js';
import FeedGrid from '../../components/wedding/Feed.jsx';
import UploadModal from '../../components/wedding/UploadModal.jsx';
import Modal from '../../components/ui/Modal.jsx';
import Spinner from '../../components/ui/Spinner.jsx';
import EmptyState from '../../components/ui/EmptyState.jsx';
import InstallApp from '../../components/ui/InstallApp.jsx';
import BottomNav, { TABS } from '../../components/feed/BottomNav.jsx';
import PhotoFeed from '../../components/feed/PhotoFeed.jsx';
import ReelFeed from '../../components/feed/ReelFeed.jsx';
import NotesFeed from '../../components/feed/NotesFeed.jsx';
import Avatar from '../../components/feed/Avatar.jsx';
import { PlusIcon } from '../../components/feed/icons.jsx';

async function downloadUrl(url, filename) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = blobUrl;
    a.download = filename;
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 4000);
  } catch {
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
  }
}

export default function GuestGallery() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { session, checkExistingSession } = useEvent();
  const [wedding, setWedding] = useState(null);
  const [guests, setGuests] = useState([]);
  const [media, setMedia] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [notLive, setNotLive] = useState(false);
  const [uploadOpen, setUploadOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saveAllOpen, setSaveAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [zipProgress, setZipProgress] = useState(null);
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState({ photos: 0, videos: 0 });
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('photos');
  const bootedRef = useRef(false);

  const deadlineRef = useMemo(
    () => (wedding ? wedding.expires_at || `${wedding.wedding_date}T23:59:59` : null),
    [wedding],
  );
  const countdown = useCountdown(deadlineRef);
  const interactions = useEventInteractions(wedding?.id, session);
  const book = useGuestbook(wedding?.id);

  const guestNameById = useMemo(
    () => Object.fromEntries(guests.map((g) => [g.id, g.full_name])),
    [guests],
  );

  const names = wedding ? [wedding.couple_name_1, wedding.couple_name_2].filter(Boolean).join(' & ') : '';
  const photos = useMemo(() => media.filter((item) => item.type === 'photo'), [media]);
  const reels = useMemo(() => media.filter((item) => item.type === 'video'), [media]);

  // Boot: resolve session for this slug, then load everything
  const boot = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabaseReady || bootedRef.current) return;
    bootedRef.current = true;
    const sessionData = await checkExistingSession(slug);
    if (!sessionData) {
      navigate(`/w/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/register`, { replace: true });
      return;
    }
    const [{ data: weddingRow }, { data: guestRows }] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('weddings').select('*').eq('slug', slug).maybeSingle(),
      supabase.from('guests').select('id, wedding_id, full_name').eq('wedding_id', sessionData.weddingId),
    ]);

    if (!weddingRow || new Date(weddingRow.expires_at) <= new Date()) {
      setNotLive(true);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setWedding(weddingRow);
    setGuests(guestRows || []);

    const { data: mediaRows } = await supabase
      .from('media')
      .select('*')
      .eq('wedding_id', weddingRow.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    setMedia(mediaRows || []);
    computeRemaining(weddingRow, mediaRows || [], sessionData);
    setLoading(false);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [slug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    boot();
  }, [boot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wedding?.id) return undefined;
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`media-${wedding.id}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'media', filter: `wedding_id=eq.${wedding.id}` },
        async () => {
          const { data } = await supabase
            .from('media')
            .select('*')
            .eq('wedding_id', wedding.id)
            .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
          setMedia(data || []);
        },
      )
      .subscribe();
    return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
  }, [wedding?.id]);

  const computeRemaining = (weddingRow, mediaRows, sessionData) => {
    if (!sessionData) return;
    const own = mediaRows.filter((m) => m.guest_id === sessionData.guestId);
    setRemaining({
      photos: Math.max(0, (weddingRow?.max_photos_per_guest ?? 10) - own.filter((m) => m.type === 'photo').length),
      videos: Math.max(0, (weddingRow?.max_videos_per_guest ?? 5) - own.filter((m) => m.type === 'video').length),
    });
  };

  const onUploaded = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('media')
      .select('*')
      .eq('wedding_id', wedding.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    setMedia(data || []);
    computeRemaining(wedding, data || [], session);
  };

  const saveAll = async () => {
    setSaveAllOpen(true);
    const zip = new JSZip();
    for (let i = 0; i < media.length; i++) {
      setZipProgress({ done: i, total: media.length, label: media[i].url.split('/').pop() });
      try {
        const blob = await (await fetch(media[i].url)).blob();
        const ext = media[i].type === 'video' ? 'mp4' : 'jpg';
        zip.file(`${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}-by-${(guestNameById[media[i].guest_id] || 'guest').replace(/\s+/g, '-')}.${ext}`, blob);
      } catch {
        /* skip */
      }
    }
    setZipProgress({ done: media.length, total: media.length, label: 'Sealing the album…' });
    const out = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' }, (meta) =>
      setZipProgress({ done: Math.round(meta.percent / 2), total: media.length, label: 'Compressing…' }),
    );
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(out);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${slug}-through-our-guests-eyes.zip`;
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 4000);
    setZipProgress(null);
    setSaveAllOpen(false);
  };

  if (!supabaseReady) {
    return <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-brown/70">Gallery is being configured.</div>;
  }
  if (loading) return <Spinner label="Beauty takes a moment…" />;

  if (notLive) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col items-center justify-center bg-cream px-6 text-center">
        <p className="font-script text-5xl text-rose">The flowers have been pressed</p>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-brown/70">
          This gallery has closed and its media removed — that happens 3 days after every wedding. We hope you saved what you loved.
        </p>
        <Link to="/" className="oge-btn-outline mt-8">← Back home</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isLive = !countdown.expired;
  const activeTabLabel = TABS.find((entry) => entry.id === tab)?.label || 'Photos';

  const emptyPhotos = (
    <div className="px-4 py-10">
      <EmptyState icon="📷" title="No photos yet" subtitle="Be the first to share a moment from today.">
        <button type="button" className="oge-btn-primary mt-3" onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)} disabled={!isLive}>
          Snap the first photo
        </button>
      </EmptyState>
    </div>
  );

  const emptyReels = (
    <div className="px-4 py-10">
      <EmptyState icon="🎬" title="No reels yet" subtitle="Hold the shutter in the camera to record a clip of up to 20 seconds.">
        <button type="button" className="oge-btn-primary mt-3" onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)} disabled={!isLive}>
          Record a reel
        </button>
      </EmptyState>
    </div>
  );

  const emptyNotes = (
    <div className="px-4 py-6">
      <EmptyState icon="✉️" title="No notes yet" subtitle="Your words will be the first keepsake here." />
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-dvh bg-cream pb-[calc(var(--oge-nav-h)+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex h-[var(--oge-header-h)] items-center gap-3 border-b border-brown/10 bg-cream/95 px-3 backdrop-blur">
        <Avatar name={names || 'Wedding'} size="md" ring />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate font-display text-[15px] font-semibold text-brown-dark">{names || 'A Celebration'}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-brown/50">
            {isLive
              ? `Closes in ${countdown.days}d ${countdown.hours}h · ${activeTabLabel}`
              : 'Gallery closed · save what you love'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)}
          disabled={!isLive}
          aria-label="Share a moment"
          className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-brown/20 bg-white text-brown transition hover:border-gold hover:text-gold disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          <PlusIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
        </button>
      </header>

      {!isLive ? (
        <div className="mx-4 mt-6 rounded-2xl bg-brown/90 p-8 text-center text-cream">
          <p className="font-display text-xl font-semibold">The gallery has closed</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-cream/80">All media was removed after the 3-day window. The couple now holds every keepsake.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {tab === 'photos' && (
            <PhotoFeed
              photos={photos}
              guestNameById={guestNameById}
              likes={interactions.likes}
              comments={interactions.comments}
              session={session}
              onToggleLike={interactions.toggleLike}
              onAddComment={interactions.addComment}
              onDownload={(item) => downloadUrl(item.url, item.url.split('/').pop())}
              emptyState={emptyPhotos}
            />
          )}

          {tab === 'reels' && (
            <ReelFeed
              reels={reels}
              guestNameById={guestNameById}
              likes={interactions.likes}
              comments={interactions.comments}
              session={session}
              onToggleLike={interactions.toggleLike}
              onAddComment={interactions.addComment}
              onDownload={(item) => downloadUrl(item.url, item.url.split('/').pop())}
              emptyState={emptyReels}
            />
          )}

          {tab === 'notes' && (
            <NotesFeed
              messages={book.messages}
              loading={book.loading}
              canWrite={isLive && Boolean(session)}
              onSubmit={book.addMessage}
              session={session}
              emptyState={emptyNotes}
            />
          )}

          {tab === 'gallery' && (
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-4 px-3 py-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-brown/45">
                  {media.length} moment{media.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={saveAll}
                  disabled={media.length === 0}
                  className="rounded-full border border-brown/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-brown/80 transition hover:border-gold hover:text-brown disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  Save all
                </button>
              </div>
              <FeedGrid
                media={media}
                guestNameById={guestNameById}
                likes={interactions.likes}
                comments={interactions.comments}
                session={session}
                onToggleLike={interactions.toggleLike}
                onAddComment={interactions.addComment}
                onDownload={(item) => downloadUrl(item.url, item.url.split('/').pop())}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      <BottomNav active={tab} onChange={setTab} onUpload={() => setUploadOpen(true)} uploadDisabled={!isLive} />

      {isLive && session && (
        <UploadModal
          open={uploadOpen}
          onClose={() => setUploadOpen(false)}
          wedding={wedding}
          remaining={remaining}
          session={session}
          onUploaded={onUploaded}
        />
      )}

      <Modal open={saveAllOpen} onClose={() => !zipProgress && setSaveAllOpen(false)} title="Sealing your keepsake…">
        <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-brown/70">Gathering {media.length} files from every guest into one pocket album.</p>
        <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-beige">
          <div
            className="h-full bg-gold transition-all"
            style={{ width: `${zipProgress && media.length ? (zipProgress.done / media.length) * 100 : 0}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-center text-xs text-brown/60">{zipProgress?.label}</p>
      </Modal>

      <InstallApp raised />
    </div>
  );
}

+import { useState } from 'react';

+function NoteCard({ note, author }) {
+  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
+
+  return (
+    <article className="rounded-2xl border border-brown/10 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-card">
+      <header className="flex items-center gap-3">
+        <Avatar name={author} size="md" />

+          <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-brown-dark">{author}</p>
+          <p className="text-[11px] text-brown/45">{dayjs(note.created_at).format('D MMM · HH:mm')}</p>
+        </div>
+        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-brown/35">note</span>
+      </header>
+
+      <p
+        onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
+        className={`mt-2.5 whitespace-pre-wrap font-body text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink/90 ${expanded ? '' : 'line-clamp-5'}`}
+      >
+        {note.body}
+      </p>
+    </article>
+  );
+}
+
+export default function NotesFeed({ messages, loading, canWrite, onSubmit, session, emptyState }) {
+  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
+  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
+
+  const submit = async (event) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    if (!body.trim()) return;
+    setSending(true);
+    setError(null);
+    try {
+      await onSubmit(body.trim());
+      setBody('');
+    } catch (err) {
+      setError(err.message || 'The note could not be posted.');
+    } finally {
+      setSending(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[470px] space-y-3 px-3 py-4">
+      {canWrite && (
+        <form onSubmit={submit} className="rounded-2xl border border-brown/10 bg-white p-3 shadow-card">
+          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
+            <Avatar name={session?.fullName || 'Guest'} size="md" ring />
+            <textarea
+              value={body}
+              onChange={(event) => setBody(event.target.value)}
+              placeholder="Leave a note for the newlyweds…"
+              maxLength={1000}
+              rows={3}
+              className="min-h-[74px] flex-1 resize-y bg-transparent font-body text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink placeholder:text-brown/40 focus:outline-none"
+            />
+          </div>
+          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-brown/10 pt-2">
+            <span className="text-[11px] text-brown/40">{body.length}/1000</span>
+            <button type="submit" className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-gold hover:text-brown" disabled={sending || !body.trim()}>
+              {sending ? 'Posting…' : 'Post note'}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+          {error && <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-rose-dark">{error}</p>}
+        </form>
+      )}
+
+      {loading ? (
+        <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-brown/50">Opening the notes…</p>
+      ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
+        emptyState
+      ) : (
+        messages.map((message) => (
+          <NoteCard
+            key={message.id}
+            note={message}
+            author={message.guests?.full_name || 'A guest'}
+          />
+        ))
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
